_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The Lord himself gives a sign: a young woman shall bear a son.
And they shall call his name Immanuel, God with us.
Greetings, favored one; the Lord is with you.
Let it be to us according to your word.
A body you have prepared; behold, I have come to do your will.
Nothing will be impossible with God.
Come, let us worship the Word made flesh.
Our souls magnify the Lord. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Picture an ordinary room, an ordinary girl, and then the air bright with an angel, and the words: greetings, favored one.
Let it be to us according to your word.
She was troubled, and afraid, and asked how this could be; and the answer was the Spirit, the power of the Most High overshadowing her.
Let it be to us according to your word.
This is the sign Isaiah promised: a virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and his name will be God-with-us.
Let it be to us according to your word.
For a body has been prepared, and the eternal Word says, behold, I have come to do your will, O God.
Let it be to us according to your word.
Nothing is impossible with God; what he speaks, he does. Come, let us worship the Word made flesh.
Let it be to us according to your word. Our souls magnify the Lord. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The angel comes to an ordinary room: greetings, favored one.
Let it be to us according to your word.
A virgin shall bear a son, and call him Immanuel.
Let it be to us according to your word.
Behold, I have come to do your will, O God.
Let it be to us according to your word.
Come, let us worship the Word made flesh.
Let it be to us according to your word. Amen.
